title: astragalus squammulosus
intro: Astragalus squammulosus, commonly known as the Himalayan milkvetch or squammosus milkvetch, is a type of flowering plant belonging to the legume family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving immune function, and protecting against oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Astragalus squammulosus are attributed to its ability to exhibit anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immunomodulatory effects. Its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties.
